## Pattern: C4 diagram scope
**Context:** User asks for architecture diagrams for a large system
**Action:** Start with Context level (C4-L1), ask for confirmation before going deeper
**Result:** ✅ Prevents over-engineering; user gets the right level of detail
**Date:** 2026-05-30

---

## Pattern: ADR numbering
**Context:** Creating a new ADR when project already has existing ADRs
**Action:** Always read project-decisions-log.md first to get the next sequential ADR number
**Result:** ✅ No duplicate ADR numbers; consistent numbering
**Date:** 2026-05-30
